detailed_description: ROI Calculator is a comprehensive investment analysis tool that helps you calculate return on investment instantly. Enter your initial investment, final value, and time period to get ROI percentage, annualized returns, and profit/loss analysis. Perfect for evaluating investment performance and comparing different investment opportunities.
usage_steps: Enter the final value of your investment
Specify the time period in years or months
Check the annualized ROI for comparison
See your total profit or loss
usage_examples: Calculate stock investment returns over 3 years
Compare ROI of different investment options
